**Finding: MISSING** (LOL-CAP, critical) — confidence 0.88

**What I checked**
- Full section outline and every paragraph of the operative body (Sections 1–10), plus targeted searches for "liability", "damages", "consequential", "indemnif" and "warrant".
- Section 9 (Warranties) contains only corporate-authority reps and the Globix carve-out — no disclaimer or cap hidden there.
- Section 10 (General Provisions) contains no liability provision; the only "liability" hits (p0061–p0062) are no-joint-venture language.
- Section 3 (Fees) — the Company pays HDI 30% of Net Sales above $11,000/month, so a 12-month fee basis is a meaningful (not illusory) cap.

**Conclusion**
The Agreement has no limitation of liability, no aggregate cap, and no exclusion of indirect/consequential damages anywhere. Because the rule expects a clause and none exists, this is *missing* rather than a deviation.

**Redline (validated ok:true)** — new Section 9(c) inserted after p0058, at the preferred position:
- Mutual cap: greater of amounts paid or payable by the Company under Section 3 in the preceding 12 months and USD 1,000,000.
- Mutual exclusion of indirect, incidental, special, consequential and punitive damages.
- Uncapped "Excluded Claims": confidentiality/data protection/security, indemnification, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud, and infringement of the other party's IP (including the Marks).
- The Company's Section 3 payment obligations are expressly not capped damages.

Comment offers the fallback (straight 12-month fee cap with the same carve-outs) if HDI resists the USD 1,000,000 floor.
